entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`rowId` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `id` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `mime` TEXT NOT NULL, `size` INTEGER NOT NULL, `updated` INTEGER NOT NULL, `fileKey` BLOB, `body` TEXT, `pinned` INTEGER NOT NULL, `searchText` TEXT NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_items_id
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_items_id` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id`)

indices.name: index_items_pinned_updated_rowId
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_items_pinned_updated_rowId` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`pinned`, `updated`, `rowId`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`name` TEXT NOT NULL, `searchText` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`items`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_item_search_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `items` BEGIN DELETE FROM `item_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_item_search_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `items` BEGIN DELETE FROM `item_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_item_search_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `items` BEGIN INSERT INTO `item_search`(`docid`, `name`, `searchText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name`, NEW.`searchText`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_item_search_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `items` BEGIN INSERT INTO `item_search`(`docid`, `name`, `searchText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`name`, NEW.`searchText`); END
